compat.text: Sikafloor® MultiFlex PS-32 UV is a multipurpose, tough-elastic smooth polyurethane flooring system . Sikafloor® MultiFlex PS-32 UV is especially designed for use in different indoor industrial, commercial and healthcare applications where seamless, UV colour stable, smooth and matt hardwearing floors are required
